context: Hina-young talks to Sakura about her admiration for a famous author.
purpose: Teen sharing role-model love with adult mentor.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: さくらさん、憧れの作家、いる。
lines.en: Sakura, there's an author I really admire.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Childlike wonder in the voice — this is someone she looks up to. Leans forward slightly. Seeks approval and connection in the same breath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Leans in to listen. No condescension — this is a real question from someone who knows eight-year-olds notice everything worth noticing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 尊敬してる作家、有名な人。
lines.en: An author I really respect — someone really famous.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly breathless. Building confidence as she speaks. The words matter to her. Trails off with a tiny uplift, like she's waiting to see if this matters to Sakura too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Your dream might be closer than you think.
lines.style: Soft, steady warmth. Knowing half-smile in the voice. Not dismissive — genuinely encouraging. The kind of thing a teen says when they suddenly see a child's potential clearly.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, I'm gonna work really hard!
lines.style: Bright, energized. The words tumble out with commitment. Pure eight-year-old determination. A little bouncy — the kind of promise a child makes when they feel truly seen.
